title: NONPOWER-S1532: total merge-loss margins at exact depth ceil(15sqrt(n)/32)

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s,n=ceil(log2N),the SINGLE NONPOWER-S1532 algorithm of proof.md/qudit_decoder.md/robust_decoder.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. Mainn>=2^48 uses exact m=ceil(15sqrt(n)/32), computed as least integer with1024m^2>=225n, exact nonpower intermediate lengths M_i=(1-2^(i-m-2))2^(base+i), base=ceil(n/(m+1)-m/2)+2, final full2^d root, measured leafrange, explicit rank/division/inverseinterval merge and proved conditional bucket moments, summed residual losses under base>=4m+64u, and freshtrial renewal, bmax=floor(H/2)-1024u, per-block r=b+ceilLog(n^5), ONE explicit wide-top coarse batch, sequential signed odd/twoadic vectors and ONE global A=4Lblk fine-attempt cap. All source rejections, failed/missing/capped attempts, incorrect histories, bit operations, actual lookups, addresses, source/extraction, table/circuit generation, explicit finiteprecision Clifford+T synthesis, initialization,gates,measurements,resets and ALL acquired/discarded/padded1024-copy microbanks count. ALLFOUR bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch,with separately proved finite exhaustive correctness and uniform absolute resource constants. F(n)=(2273/960)n^(1/2) is the complete exact exponent. Resource envelopes usepositive n2 values atn1. Total charged work O(n^(5/2)2^F), exact index1/2.
